search_configuration.operator_scope: Plan: algebraic then full elementary operators; actual completed stages are in search_stages and depend on remaining budget.
search_configuration.simplicity_preference: Linear seeds plus parameter/complexity-aware selection within resolution tolerance.

warnings: Search loss uses finite-difference acceleration, not independent prediction.
All selected probes are discovery data and cannot serve as independent validation.
Constant/absent properties do not establish absence of physical dependence.
Body positions are not included; explicit t may substitute for unobserved body motion.
Resolution tolerance is a finite-stencil sensitivity heuristic, not a confidence interval.
Short rollout checks certify only acquired initial states; fit and fresh-probe validation remain required.

data_quality.trajectory_checks: executability only; reported RMSE is training diagnostic, not accuracy certification

projection_diagnostics.hypothesis: acceleration equals an unknown scalar response times position
projection_diagnostics.scope: Acquired-data hypothesis only; not proof of isotropy or an origin force source.
